يتصاعدوا (form VI)
# يَتَصَاعَدُوا (yataṣāʕadū) /ja.ta.sˤaː.ʕa.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَصَاعَدَ (taṣāʕada)
# يُتَصَاعَدُوا (yutaṣāʕadū) /ju.ta.sˤaː.ʕa.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَصَاعَدَ (taṣāʕada)
